title: vatica odorata subsp. mindanensis
intro: Vatica odorata subsp. mindanensis, commonly known as Mindanao ironwood, is a subspecies of evergreen tree native to the Philippines. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vatica odorata subsp. mindanensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to possess potential therapeutic properties, including free radical scavenging, anti-proliferative, and anti-cancer activities.
